repo.description:
### Impact

Authenticated users were able to view meta data of columns in other tables of the Tables app by modifying the numeric ID in a request.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Tables app is upgraded to 0.8.7 or 0.9.4

### Workarounds

* Disable app Tables

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3138721)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/tables/pull/1891)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Tables app allowed users to view columns metadata information of any table
